notes: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md in full. The skill gives migration code patterns for Sequelize, TypeORM and Prisma: adding/renaming/retyping columns, data transformations, transaction- and backup-table-based rollback, expand/contract zero-downtime phases and dialect-aware cross-database migrations.

No direct commands, installs, credentials, or network access: the only run instructions are ORM CLI invocations in code comments (e.g. `npx sequelize-cli db:migrate`, `npx prisma migrate deploy`) that the user runs against their own database.

Users should know: several examples drop columns or tables in `up` (e.g. SKILL.md:186, 234, 319 and references/details.md:36) and the checkpoint rollback recreates `users` via CREATE TABLE AS, which loses indexes/constraints; review and back up before applying migrations to production data.
